correction: Warn on existing violations while rejecting new violations and baseline growth.
mechanization: Execute correction-ratchet.mjs against the exact Git base in required CI, with behavioral tests rejecting changed values, new findings, and baseline growth.

codebase.rationale: This invariant governs repository correction guards and edits to their baselines, outside an application runtime path.

static.rationale: The required CI runner compares complete findings with immutable base evidence, and regression tests exercise the real scanner and Git snapshots.

guard.anchor: baseline edits cannot grandfather new violations

correction: Production web analytics must not default to the development tier when the public tier variable is absent.
mechanization: Bake an explicit or deployment-derived Statsig tier into the public Next.js build and retain a production-safe client fallback; Jest checks both configuration and SDK initialization.

codebase.rationale: Build-time configuration exposes the resolved deployment tier to browser code, and the client fallback prevents a production build from silently using development.

guard.anchor: never defaults a production browser client to development

correction: Every web waitlist funnel event must identify the rendering landing using required props while excluding contact and health values.
mechanization: Require typed landing identity props on WaitlistForm and allowlist the rendered IDs; Jest drives every rendering landing through its full funnel and checks schema retention and privacy.

codebase.rationale: Required closed-value props replace shared hard-coded identity, every shared-form event includes the same identity, and the analytics schema rejects contact and health metadata.

guard.anchor: attributes the complete %s funnel to the rendered landing

correction: Do not assign homepage visitors an audience or set an experiment cookie when the rendering page does not consume the split.
mechanization: Remove audience allocation, cookie creation and internal rewrites from homepage middleware; Jest verifies fresh, campaign, returning and internal-query visits with the legacy flag enabled.

codebase.rationale: Removing the unused audience-routing branch prevents allocation and cookie writes at the request entry point without changing the independent editorial rollout.

guard.anchor: does not split or cookie homepage traffic
